current.text: He is coming off back surgery. His Yahoo status is questionable (Back).
Jaxson Hayes started at center in the preseason, and Filipowski is back in the rotation as a backup.
He is expected to drop to third string at center when Jusuf Nurkic returns. Experts see no path for him to the starting center job.
Utah has a crowded frontcourt with Jaren Jackson Jr., Lauri Markkanen, Nurkic, Hayes and Ace Bailey.
Utah is trying to win this season and is projected as a playoff team. His role should shrink, with a shorter leash, and he will not get the 28 minutes he played late last season.
Experts think his late-season rise last year (about 39th after the deadline) came in tanking stretches and will not repeat.

durable.text: He is one of the worst defensive bigs in the NBA. He also does not rebound on defense, which makes him a bad fit next to Jaren Jackson Jr.
He has good offensive skills, but his three-point shooting is weak.
He has never been a shot blocker. He makes few blocks for a big man and gets some steals.
Rebounds are his best fantasy category.
